tldr: Two finite-population causal means share one treatment assignment. For arbitrary fixed enrollment order and the stipulated unit cube without an energy floor, the established theory computably characterizes the positive leading minimax coefficient \(C_{\mathrm{two}}\): a terminating arbitrary-tolerance two-sided rational evaluator and an original-record design give \(TC_{\mathrm{two}}\le R_T\le TC_{\mathrm{two}}+400T^{5/6}\). No informative executed full-class numerical enclosure or equality with \(c_0\) is established, and the remainder is not claimed sharp. A separate perturbative converse now embeds the shared-prefix construction in the explicitly represented coordinatewise two-metric analogue of scalar energy-floor, fourth-moment, and correlation conditions. Replacing zero entries by \(\delta\) gives a fixed-table lower bound \((c_0-8\delta^2)T-16\); \(\delta=1/10\) retains more than half of \(c_0\). This lower-subclass result does not transfer the headline upper theorem or identify the full published scalar classes. Generic linearity and static common-allocation optimization remain inherited.
gap: Scalar Neyman regret can vanish under the published regularity conditions, while terminal protection of several cumulative losses already has a generic linear barrier.
